summary: Iteration 899 backend-only independent confirmation of the 5 nightly monitoring email fixes on RealAICoach. critical_code_review_comments: Non-blocking: routes/autonomous_engine/zero_trust.py:909 caps SAST scan at py_files[:200] (only ~17% of 1175 backend .py files). Fine for a smoke gate but by design cannot catch a secret introduced deep in a large sub-tree. Consider either full-scan with sampling or documenting the intent.

Non-blocking: routes/code_health_scanner.py uses a plain regex-based scanner (no AST). The new implementation is scope-aware for its explicit vectors (hook deps + synchronous useMemo body) which eliminated the 46 false positives, but any future TDZ-like patterns (e.g., useLayoutEffect deps, synchronous useCallback body calls to consts declared later) would need explicit additions. Current coverage matches the RCA and is intentionally narrow.
Non-blocking: utils/email_templates.py is very large (>8900 lines). Recommend eventual split by category/domain, though current change (~lines 7601-7628) is localized and correct.
Non-blocking: scheduler.py at ~line 4055-4090 uses a StopAsyncIteration-as-early-return sentinel inside a plain try — works, but a small helper function would be cleaner.
